beats.text: Read its safeguards alongside the cases where delay can also preserve suffering.

beats.text: The human and artificial voices expose different limits, rather than combining into a final moral authority.

beats.text: The full inquiry offers a demanding way to examine philanthropy, intervention, and institutional ambition.
